name: Avarice
overview: The Scriptures reveal avarice through the example of the descendants of Joseph, who expressed dissatisfaction with the inheritance allotted to them despite being a great and blessed people. Joshua's response encourages them to claim more territory by their own effort, even in the face of strong opposition from the Canaanites with iron chariots, highlighting both their potential and the challenge of covetous desire. This narrative illustrates the tension between rightful ambition and greed, while Ecclesiastes reminds us of the vanity that can accompany such earthly pursuits under the sun.
